title: rhaphidorhynchus citratus
intro: Rhaphidorhynchus citratus, commonly known as the 'Sour Lemon Plant', is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits in aiding digestion, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhaphidorhynchus citratus include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
